description: "Balance of Power: Late Edition" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, US Senator Elizabeth Warren (D-MA) discusses the hearing of Fed Chair nominee Kevin Warsh and President Trump's Iran strategy. Barbara Leaf, distinguished diplomatic fellow at the Middle East Institute, discusses whether or not she is encouraged by President Trump saying the Iran ceasefire will extend until Iran's proposal is submitted. Senator Kevin Cramer (R-ND) shares his reaction to a small group of unauthorized users gaining access to Anthropic’s Mythos AI and what risks this might pose.  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Iran Ceasefire Extending Until Talks Conclude | Balance of Power: Late Edition 04/21/2026

author: Tom Rees
description: The war in Iran could wipe out most of Rachel Reeves’ fiscal buffer, according to new research pointing to a £16 billion ($22 billion) hit to Britain’s public finances.
title: Iran War May Erase Most of UK Chancellor’s Buffer, Research Says

author: Joe Mayes
description: The UK and France will hold a fresh summit of military planners to discuss how the Strait of Hormuz can be kept open, as Prime Minister Keir Starmer and President Emmanuel Macron continue a diplomatic push to restore free transit through the vital shipping route.
title: UK, France Convene Fresh Hormuz Summit on Re-Opening Planning

description: Senator Kevin Cramer (R-ND) shares his reaction to a small group of unauthorized users gaining access to Anthropic’s Mythos AI and what risks this might pose. He also discusses President Trump’s Fed Chair nominee Kevin Warsh’s hearing and the debate surrounding Fed independence, and his thoughts on Trump extending the Iran ceasefire until talks conclude. Senator Cramer speaks with Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg’s “Balance of Power.” (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Senator Cramer on Mythos AI, Kevin Warsh, Iran Ceasefire

author: Josh Wingrove, Enda Curran, Saleha Mohsin
description: The biggest question facing Kevin Warsh was answered before he even reached the committee room Tuesday when President Donald Trump doubled down on a criminal probe that is effectively blocking his own nominee from taking over at the Federal Reserve.
title: Trump and Tillis in Battle of Wills With Warsh’s Fate in Balance

description: Barbara Leaf, distinguished diplomatic fellow at the Middle East Institute and former US Assistant Secretary of State for Near Eastern Affairs, discusses whether or not she is encouraged by President Trump saying the Iran ceasefire will extend until Iran's proposal is submitted. She shares her insight as to what’s next to get officials to the negotiating table and what to make of the mixed messaging on both sides. She speaks with Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg’s “Balance of Power.” (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Leaf on What’s Next Following Iran Ceasefire Extension

description: A small group of unauthorized users have accessed Anthropic PBC’s new Mythos AI model, a technology that the company says is so powerful it can enable dangerous cyberattacks, according to a person familiar with the matter and documentation viewed by Bloomberg News. Michael Shepard has more on "Balance of Power: Evening Edition." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Anthropic's Mythos AI Model Accessed by Unauthorized Users

author: Mike Dorning
description: Senator Elizabeth Warren assailed Federal Reserve chair nominee Kevin Warsh’s performance in his confirmation hearing on Tuesday, saying he had failed to demonstrate the will to defy President Donald Trump.
title: Elizabeth Warren Says Warsh Testimony Shows Lack of Independence

author: Jimmy Jenkins, Chris Strohm
description: The US Justice Department brought bank fraud charges against the Southern Poverty Law Center related to payments made to informants of alleged extremist groups including the Ku Klux Klan, Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche and FBI Director Kash Patel said Tuesday.
title: DOJ Charges Southern Poverty Law Center With Bank Fraud

description: US Senator Elizabeth Warren, a Massachusetts Democrat, criticizes President Donald Trump for not having a plan regarding the Iran conflict. Senator Warren speaks on "Balance of Power: Evening Edition." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Senator Warren Says Republicans Needs to 'Grow a Backbone' on Iran

description: US Senator Elizabeth Warren, a Massachusetts Democrat, says Republicans need to "grow a backbone" and stand up to President Donald Trump regarding the war in Iran. Speaking on "Balance of Power: Evening Edition," Senator Warren also discusses Federal Reserve Chair Nominee Kevin Warsh's testimony before the Senate Banking Committee. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Senator Warren on War in Iran, Warsh and Fed Independence

author: Edward Bolingbroke
description: Traders are building up bets that bond market volatility will keep falling, even as a US-Iran peace agreement remains elusive.
title: Bond Traders Bet on Post-War Calm to Keep Rates in Tight Range

author: Nancy Cook
description: The departures of three officials followed a spate of controversies.
title: Trump’s Cabinet Gets a Shuffle as Political Pressures Build

description: On today's episode of Bloomberg Businessweek Daily, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec speak with Bloomberg News Senior Editor Wendy Benjaminson about the market reaction to Vice President Vance putting his Iran trip on hold. Then, Bloomberg International Economics and Policy Correspondent Mike McKee discusses the Senate hearing for Kevin Warsh's Fed chair nomination. Plus, Jitania Kandhari of Morgan Stanley Investment Management weighs in on market reaction to both Iran and Warsh. Then, Bloomberg News Managing Editor for Global Consumer Tech Mark Gurman discusses Apple's C-suite shake-up with John Ternus set to take over for Tim Cook. Finally, Anil Chakravarthy, Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration President on the company's major tech partnerships to form an agentic AI ecosystem. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Stocks Decline as US-Iran Talks Remain Uncertain | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 4/21/2026

author: Alex Wickham, Joe Mayes, Rose Henderson
description: Forty-eight hours of brutal public inquiry into Keir Starmer’s judgment have left the prime minister looking increasingly like a lame duck.
title: Mandelson Vetting Fiasco Leaves Starmer Looking Like Lame Duck

description: Kevin Warsh repeatedly pledged to act independently if he’s confirmed as the next Federal Reserve chair in testimony before the Senate Banking Committee Tuesday. Tyler Kendall breaks down the key takeaways from the hearing. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: What to Know From Kevin Warsh’s Senate Hearing

description: On the early edition of Balance of Power, Bloomberg Washington Correspondents Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz discuss Kevin Warsh's confirmation hearing to be the next Chairman of the Federal Reserve. On today's show, Groundwork Collaborative Senior Strategic Advisor Kitty Richards, Harvard Kennedy School Ash Center Visiting Democracy Fellow Jeanne Sheehan Zaino, Hoover Institution Fellow Lanhee Chen and former Republican Congressman Patrick McHenry. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Warsh's Fed Confirmation Hearing | Balance of Power: Early Edition 4/21/2026

author: Courtney Subramanian, Jennifer A Dlouhy
description: Peace talks between the US and Iran ground to a standstill on Tuesday, with reports stating that Vice President JD Vance put off a planned trip to Pakistan and Iranian officials refused to attend.
title: US, Iran Peace Talks Uncertain With Vance Trip Scrapped

author: Nacha Cattan
description: A businessman who garnered headlines last year with a prominent “Vote for Trump” sign received President Donald Trump’s endorsement in the race to fill Elise Stefanik’s House seat in upstate New York.
title: Trump Endorses Former Boxer for Stefanik’s Seat in Upstate NY

description: Bloomberg Opinion columnist and former president of the Federal Reserve Bank of New York Bill Dudley says Kevin Warsh needs to tune out all the pressure from President Donald Trump. He says Warsh can't vote for an interest rate cut in June unless the war with Iran is over. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Warsh Needs to Tune Out Trump Pressure, Dudley Says

author: Tyler Kendall
description: Republican Senator Thom Tillis signaled openness to advancing Kevin Warsh’s nomination to be Federal Reserve chair if an ongoing US criminal inquiry into the central bank is dropped and Congress launches its own investigation.
title: Tillis Signals Openness to Warsh Vote If Congress Adds Fed Probe

author: Ian Kullgren, Parker Purifoy, Brett Samuels
description: President Donald Trump summoned three top labor leaders to the White House for a private meeting last week.
title: Inside the Downfall of Trump’s Scandal-Plagued Labor Secretary

author: Alex Longley, Jack Farchy, Archie Hunter
description: The impact of the Iran war will continue for months even after any deal to restore shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, the world’s largest oil traders have warned. Some said flows through the waterway may never return to normal.
title: Top Oil Traders Say Billion-Barrel Shock to Echo Long After War

author: Vinicius Andrade, Jorgelina Do Rosario, Nicolle Yapur, Jennifer A Dlouhy
description: A group of Venezuelan bond investors met for the first time with Trump administration officials last week, holding talks on their potential role in the nation’s economic recovery.
title: Venezuela Creditors Met With Trump Officials to Discuss Rebuild

author: Carla Samon Ros, Marcelo Rochabrun
description: Leftist Roberto Sánchez is in second place by a razor-thin margin in the official vote count following Peru’s presidential election, as hundreds of thousands of challenged ballots must now be reviewed to confirm if he’ll advance to a June 7 runoff.
title: Leftist Holds Shaky Lead in Race to Peru Presidential Runoff

author: Kavita Mokha
description: French President Emmanuel Macron said Israel must “renounce its territorial ambitions” in Lebanon and that Hezbollah should be disarmed “by the Lebanese.”
title: Macron Urges Israel to Drop ‘Territorial Ambitions’ in Lebanon

author: Mathieu Dion
description: Prime Minister Mark Carney’s government is extending its campaign to assert Canadian sovereignty all the way into space.
title: Canada Unveils Space-Launch Bill Aimed at Cutting Reliance on US

author: Alicia Diaz
description: Representative Sheila Cherfilus-McCormick, a Florida Democrat, resigned from Congress Tuesday amid allegations that she stole pandemic relief funds.
title: Democrat Cherfilus-McCormick Quits House After Theft Allegations

author: Selcan Hacaoglu, Jorge Valero
description: The European Union sought to ease tensions with Turkey after European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen named the country alongside Russia and China, creating the impression that the NATO partner was seen as a potential threat.
title: EU Seeks to Defuse Squabble With Turkey Over Von der Leyen Gaffe

author: Jen Judson
description: The Navy plans to deploy Patriot missile interceptors aboard US warships in an effort to better protect American vessels from enemy drones and missiles, officials said Tuesday.
title: Navy Moves to Arm US Warships With Lockheed’s Patriot Missiles

description: Kevin Warsh, President Donald Trump's nominee for Federal Reserve chair, says he'd be an independent actor if confirmed, and he says Trump never asked him to commit to any particular rate decision. Warsh testified before the Senate Banking Committee. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Warsh Says He'd Be an Independent Actor as Fed Chair

description: Senator Thom Tillis, a Republican from North Carolina, says he supports Kevin Warsh as the next chair of the Federal Reserve, but says he can't vote for President Trump's nominee until a "bogus investigation" of renovations at the Fed is over.  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Tillis Says DOJ Investigation of Fed Has to End

author: Melissa Shin
description: Ontario’s representative to the US said he’s confident an agreement to resolve trade frictions between Canada and the US is possible in 2026.
title: US-Canada Trade Deal Is Within Reach in 2026, Ontario Envoy Says

description: "Absolutely not," Federal Reserve Chair Nominee Kevin Warsh says while responding to a question from Senator John Kennedy of Louisiana about whether he would be a “sock puppet” for President Donald Trump during testimony before the Senate Banking Committee. Warsh also says President Trump has not asked him to commit to any rate decision. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Warsh Says He Will Not Be Trump's 'Sock Puppet'

author: Ari Natter, Will Kubzansky
description: US gasoline prices likely peaked last week, Energy Secretary Chris Wright said Tuesday.
title: US Gasoline Prices Likely Peaked Last Week, Energy Secretary Wright Says

author: Sophie Alexander, Emily Birnbaum, Yash Roy
description: Political groups tied to the cryptocurrency industry are sitting on a nearly $180 million war chest ahead of this year’s midterm elections, giving it the ability to outspend even some of the Republican Party’s most prominent super PACs.
title: Crypto PACs Amass $180 Million War Chest for Midterm Races

description: US Senator Elizabeth Warren, a Massachusetts Democrat, accuses Federal Reserve Chair Nominee Kevin Warsh of being President Donald Trump's "sock puppet" and questions him about his undisclosed assets during testimony before the Senate Banking Committee. Warsh vows to sell his assets before taking the oath of office. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Senator Warren Clashes With Warsh Over Assets, Ties to Trump

description: Kevin Warsh, President Donald Trump's nominee to lead the Federal Reserve, says monetary policy independence is essential. During his confirmation hearing before the Senate Banking Committee, Warsh said the Fed should "stay in its lane." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Warsh Says the Fed Must Stay in Its Lane

author: Laura Curtis, Hadriana Lowenkron
description: President Donald Trump said he’d remember companies that decline to seek refunds on duties paid after the Supreme Court struck down a large swath of his tariffs.
title: Trump Encourages Companies Not to Seek Tariff Refunds

author: Alaric Nightingale
description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said repairs have been completed on the Druzhba oil pipeline, allowing the resumption of Russian oil flows to Europe and paving the way for a much-needed €90 billion ($106 billion) loan.
title: Zelenskiy Says Oil Flows Can Resume, Paving Way for EU Loan

author: Jimmy Jenkins
description: The Trump administration is facing a fresh legal challenge in its bid to collect and store voters’ personal information before the midterm elections.
title: DOJ Faces Fresh Suit Over Push to Collect Voter Information

author: Ben Sills
description: Russia detained the general director of the country’s largest publishing house as part of an extremism case as authorities deepen their crackdown on LGBTQ content.
title: Russia Detains Head of Top Publisher in Crackdown on LGBTQ Books

author: Anthony Capaccio, Roxana Tiron
description: The Pentagon’s largest-ever budget request earmarks $75 billion for drones and technologies to counter them, mainly for a massive increase for a little-known office working with US commandos to test and evaluate various systems, according to defense officials.
title: Pentagon Seeks $75 Billion for Drones in Record Defense Budget

author: Katarina Hoije
description: Russia is expanding its military logistics network in West Africa, using the port of Conakry in Guinea as a key transit hub for equipment bound for Mali, an investigation by The Sentry has found.
title: Russia Expands Sahel Arms Network Via Guinea, Sentry Probe Finds

author: Josh Wingrove
description: President Donald Trump said a currency swap with the United Arab Emirates is under consideration, as the US ally floats the prospect of seeking financial assistance to weather the fallout from the Iran war.
title: Trump Says Currency Swap With UAE Is Under Consideration

description: WASHINGTON (AP) — The Southern Poverty Law Center says it's the subject of a criminal investigation by the Justice Department and faces possible charges over its past use of paid informants to infiltrate extremist groups.
title: Southern Poverty Law Center Says It's Being Investigated by DOJ

author: Kamlesh Bhuckory
description: Mauritius’s government warned it’s considering all options to force the UK to hand over sovereignty of the Chagos Islands, after the British government put the transfer on hold because of US opposition to the deal.
title: Mauritius Hints At Legal Action If UK Scraps Chagos Islands Deal

author: Josh Wingrove, Hadriana Lowenkron
description: President Donald Trump predicted the US government would have a good relationship Anthropic PBC, a stark reversal in tone toward the artificial company that’s embroiled in a fight with the Pentagon.
title: Trump Says US Will Get Along With Anthropic After Pentagon Spat

author: Hadriana Lowenkron
description: President Donald Trump said he would like to see a buyer emerge for Spirit Aviation Holdings Inc. and was open to the government coming to the aid of the airline, while opposing a merger between American Airlines Group Inc. and United Airlines Holdings Inc.
title: Trump Wants Buyer for Spirit, Pans United-American Merger

author: Julian Lee
description: Moscow has resumed loading operations at key ports, setting the stage for a rebound in exports
title: Russia Set to Ramp Up Oil Flows as Impact of Drone Strikes Fades

author: Jennifer Duggan
description: Ireland cut this year’s economic-growth projection, citing the conflict in the Middle East.
title: Ireland Trims Economic-Growth Projections on Iran Conflict

description: Kevin Warsh Photographer: Tierney L. Cross/Bloomberg
title: Kevin Warsh’s Hearing Begins With Fed’s Actions in Focus

author: Oliver Crook, Aliaksandr Kudrytski
description: Ukraine is willing to delay access to some European Union benefits to accelerate its bid to join the bloc, Deputy Prime Minister Taras Kachka said.
title: Ukraine Says It Would Delay EU Benefits to Speed Accession

description: Around 90% of the world’s advanced semiconductors flow through the Taiwan Strait. Bloomberg Opinion columnist Karishma Vaswani explains how China could turn it into a global chokepoint. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: A Global Chip Shock Could Be Next

author: Jonathan Tamari
description: Election today and special session next week mark end of back-and-forth
title: Redistricting Fights Are Winding Down With Virginia, Florida

author: Alex Morales
description: Keir Starmer’s office tried to secure an ambassadorial role for his former communications chief Matthew Doyle, former top civil servant Olly Robbins said in a revelation that’s likely to pile further tricky questions on the prime minister about political influence in the Foreign Office.
title: Starmer’s No. 10 Sought Ambassador Role for Ex Comms Chief

author: Yian Lee
description: Taiwan abruptly canceled President Lai Ching-te’s first trip abroad in more than a year, citing pressure from China.
title: Taiwan Cancels Lai’s Eswatini Trip, Citing China Interference

author: Alan Crawford
description: Russia and NATO are facing off in an echo of Cold War-era anti-submarine warfare.
title: Putin’s Undersea Power Menaces the Atlantic

description: The US made halting progress toward a second round of talks with Iran. President Donald Trump said his vice president, JD Vance, is ready to leave for negotiations in Islamabad, but threatened to return to conflict if Iran doesn’t make a deal. For its part, Tehran didn’t confirm who, if anyone, would travel to the Pakistani capital. Bloomberg's Joumana Bercetche reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: US Makes Slow Progress Toward New Talks With Iran

description: Olly Robbins, the top UK bureaucrat who granted clearance for Peter Mandelson to take up the role as US ambassador against the recommendation of security officials, said Prime Minister Keir Starmer’s office had a “dismissive approach” to Mandelson’s vetting. He made the comments during a testimony before lawmakers in London.
title: UK PM’s Office ‘Dismissive’ of Mandelson Vetting: Official

author: Maya Averbuch
description: Flights are scarce, paperwork is hard to come by and other countries are closing their doors amid an intense US pressure campaign.
title: Cubans in Crisis Have Fewer Ways to Leave After Trump Tightens Screws

author: Alicia Diaz, Anna J Kaiser
description: America’s year-long redistricting battles are nearing their end: Virginia voters on Tuesday will decide whether to give Democrats a three-seat boost in this year’s midterm election, while Florida Republicans will have the chance next week to counter with their own congressional map to even the score.
title: Trump’s Redistricting Bids Near End With Virginia, Florida Moves

author: Andrea Palasciano, Daniel Basteiro, Max Ramsay
description: Spain called for the European Union to penalize Israel over its actions in Gaza, reviving a push after Hungarian leader Viktor Orban’s loss potentially removed one of the bloc’s biggest obstacles to taking action.
title: Spain Renews Push to Punish Israel After Orban’s Election Loss

author: Alex Wickham
description: The top UK bureaucrat who granted clearance for Peter Mandelson to take up the role as US ambassador against the recommendation of security officials said he felt pressure from Prime Minister Keir Starmer’s office to rubber-stamp an appointment that had already been announced.
title: Top UK Official Says He Felt Pressure to Approve Mandelson Role

author: Patrick Sykes
description: As the clock runs down on a two-week ceasefire agreed to by the US and Iran, the key question is whether they can reach a deal to end a war that has killed thousands of people and sparked a global energy crunch.
title: Can the US and Iran Agree to a Lasting Deal to End the War?

author: Maya Averbuch
description: Escasean los vuelos, conseguir documentos es cada vez más complicado y otros países cierran sus fronteras ante la presión de Estados Unidos.
title: Crisis y sanciones de Trump limitan las opciones a cubanos que quieren salir de la isla

author: Anders Melin, Niki Koswanage
description: Malaysia is exploring the need to develop a new digital platform to improve hiring of foreign workers, according to its Ministry of Human Resources.
title: Malaysia Says It’s Studying New Migrant Worker Hiring System

author: Frank Connelly
description: The war in the Middle East will have an estimated impact on the French budget of as much as €6 billion ($7.1 billion), Finance Minister Roland Lescure estimated in an interview with RTL radio.
title: France’s Lescure Sees Up to €6 Billion Budget Impact From War

author: Shruti Srivastava
description: Indian trade officials will seek comparative advantage over other countries during negotiations to advance a trade deal with Washington this week.
title: India Seeks Edge as US Trade Pact Nears Finish Line

author: Norman Harsono
description: Indonesian lawmakers passed a long-awaited bill to protect the millions of domestic workers, concluding years of parliamentary debate over labor rights in Southeast Asia’s largest economy.
title: Indonesia Passes Law to Protect Millions of Domestic Workers

description: A public testimony by Olly Robbins, whom Keir Starmer fired as the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office’s top civil servant over the vetting of former US Ambassador Peter Mandelson, presents the next moment of peril in the UK Prime Minister’s rocky tenure. Bloomberg Opinion’s Rosa Prince has the latest. Her views are her own.
title: Robbins, the Official Fired by Starmer, Set to Testify

author: Arsalan Shahla, Jeff Mason, Ben Bartenstein, Fiona MacDonald
description: President Donald Trump signaled he is unlikely to extend a two-week ceasefire with Iran that’s set to expire in two days, while Iran has yet to confirm it will participate in talks to end a war that’s engulfed the Middle East and upended global trade.
title: Trump Signals No Truce Extension on Eve of Scheduled Peace Talks

description: Three vessels — two cargo ships and a fuel tanker — appeared to be attempting to transit the Strait of Hormuz early on Tuesday as US and Iranian blockades remained in place. The Shoja 2, an Iranian-flagged cargo vessel, is being closely watched after the US Navy seized another Iranian cargo ship on Sunday, the first capture since Washington imposed a blockade of the waterway last week. Bloomberg's Clara Ferreira Marques reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Iranian-Flagged Cargo Ship Attempts to Cross Hormuz

author: Volodymyr Verbianyi, Olesia Safronova
description: When Ukrainian military draft officers stopped two men to check their identity documents, a passing group of youths suddenly attacked them, enabling one of the detainees to flee.
title: Attacks on Ukraine Draft Officers Soar as War Fatigue Deepens

description: From a memory crunch to global instability, Lenovo CFO Winston Cheng and NF Trinity’s Helen Zhu discuss the roadmap for AI growth and the hurdles facing the global tech buildout. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Investing in AI Amid Geopolitical and Supply Risks

author: Enda Curran, Catarina Saraiva, Amara Omeokwe, Maria Eloisa Capurro
description: Kevin Warsh, President Donald Trump’s nominee to chair the Federal Reserve, will appear before the Senate Banking Committee for a confirmation hearing at 10 a.m. Tuesday. It could be the most contentious such hearing in many decades.
title: Kevin Warsh Heads for the Hill: A Confirmation Hearing Guide

author: Benoit Berthelot
description: French billionaire Vincent Bolloré has created a Christian-inspired think tank with other wealthy business leaders to propose a conservative agenda ahead of the country’s presidential election next year.
title: Tycoon Bolloré Forms Christian Think Tank Before French Election

description: President Donald Trump said he’s not likely to extend the two-week ceasefire with Iran, increasing the urgency for negotiators to conclude a deal to end the war. Bloomberg's Joumanna Bercetche has the latest. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: What to Expect From the Next Round of US-Iran Talks

author: Weilun Soon
description: Three vessels — two cargo ships and a fuel tanker — appeared to be attempting to transit the Strait of Hormuz early on Tuesday as US and Iranian blockades remained in place.
title: Three Ships Including an Iranian Vessel Attempt Hormuz Transits

author: Sakura Murakami
description: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi made an offering to a shrine seen by Japan’s neighbors as glorifying its wartime past, in a move that stops short of a visit but may still anger China and other neighboring nations.
title: Japan’s Takaichi Risks China’s Wrath With Offering to Yasukuni

author: Laura Davison
description: The US Department of Transportation is allocating $4.7 billion to renovate New York City’s Penn Station and Washington’s Union Station, providing funds to enhance two iconic East Coast transportation hubs.
title: Penn Station to Benefit from $4.7 Billion Amtrak Funding Boost

author: Soo-Hyang Choi
description: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung rejected allegations that a minister publicly identified the location of a North Korean nuclear facility based on US intelligence, calling the accusation “absurd.”
title: South Korea’s Lee Denies US Intelligence Leak on Nuclear Site

author: Ainsley Thomson
description: New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon said his National Party reaffirmed its confidence in his leadership, as he seeks to quell persistent speculation about his future less than seven months before the nation’s election.
title: NZ Prime Minister Wins Leadership Vote as Election Looms

author: James Mayger
description: Australia will invest billions of dollars to establish anti-drone defense systems as the wars in Iran and Ukraine underscore the potency of unmanned vehicles in a rapidly evolving global security environment.
title: Australia to Invest in Anti-Drone Defenses as Iran Shows Potency

author: Alastair Gale
description: Japan removed most of its restrictions on weapons exports as it seeks to create a larger market for companies in the arms business while building a more robust base of suppliers for its own military.
title: Japan Scraps Most Weapons Export Limits in Boost to Arms Sector

author: Bill Allison
description: President Donald Trump’s super political action committee raised $35.6 million in March, bolstering his war chest to $550 million as he tries to defy history by hanging onto congressional Republican majorities in an increasingly difficult midterm election environment.
title: Trump Stockpiles $550 Million in Campaign Cash Ahead of Midterms
